title: Parsing with views
hints: `text.substr(start, count)` on a `string_view` returns another view into the same characters, so collecting words allocates nothing but the vector.
`rest.subspan(1, length)` is the field and `rest.subspan(1 + length)` is everything after it. Check the size first, so a short buffer never reads past its end.
The `std::optional` result holds either a span or nothing: `return field;` gives a value and `return std::nullopt;` gives nothing. The caller writes `if (auto field{ nextField(rest) }) use(*field);`.
